title: Borderless zone overlays
description: Render zone overlays as translucent semantic areas without normal border strokes, while preserving boundary outlines and subgraph dashed guides.
completion_criteria: Zone overlay boxes have translucent fill and no normal stroke.
Zone palette styles no longer emit zone stroke CSS variables.
Boundary boxes remain outlined and subgraphs remain unfilled dashed guides.
Selected zones can still show an interaction outline.
Syntax and AI authoring documentation describe the updated visual semantics.
Focused render tests, typecheck, and production build pass.
success_criteria: Zone overlays reduce visual noise in dense diagrams.
Authors can distinguish placement/ownership zones from trust/policy boundaries.
Existing zone layout, collapse/expand behavior, and selection behavior remain intact.
triage_notes: Normal zone borders are removed; selected zones may still draw a temporary outline for usability.
